chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father together, from Ibn Mahboub, from Dawood al-Raqy, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

There is no creation more numerous than the Angels. Indeed, every night seventy thousand Angels descend from the sky, and they circumambulate the Sacred House during their night, and similarly every day.
ai.seo_question: How many angels descend to the Kaaba every day according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) narrates that the angels are the most numerous of all creations, with seventy thousand descending daily to circumambulate the Kaaba, highlighting the continuous worship of the celestial beings. This hadith, found in al-Kafi, underscores the concept of *Tawaf* extending beyond the physical realm, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the Kaaba as a spiritual axis connecting heaven and earth. The specific number 'seventy thousand' is often interpreted by scholars as indicating a distinct group of angels performing this ritual each day, emphasizing the perpetual nature of divine servitude.
